notes.title: PWPDX BETA BRANCH
notes.notes:
Penguin with a Pumpgun DX, which was announced some time ago is now playable in it's current state on the BETA branch. I've decided to unlock it so that players that might want to have a look at what's incoming can do so.

Keep in mind that this is a work-in-progress branch, that means:
!!! Expect errors and in worst case a non-beatable game. !!!

To play the beta-branch, go to properties of Penguin With A Pumpgun, then BETAS and pick beta.

Currently known bugs (that are on the fix list):
[list]
[*] Music breaks at different events.
[*] Force Field Melee powerup is a bit broken position-wise.
[*] Mystical hidden monster sometimes hits collision grenades, causing unexpected explosion.
[*] Missing Timed Powerups.
[*] Not all boss rooms have money divided onto monsters.
[/list]

I'll create a discussion where you are more than welcome to bring in thoughts and/or feedback.
I am listening.

Thanks for playing, I hope you like where the game is going.

Best,
Lasse

notes.title: Penguin with a Pumpgun DX
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing.

I've been playing Penguin with a Pumpgun a lot.
Maybe so much that I overlooked some critical stuff during the testing of the game.
I have decided to update Penguin with a Pumpgun with an incoming patch.
ETA: Still to be determined.

The new version will include, among other stuff,
* Shop where you can buy stuff
* 5 new weapons
* New powerup system - power ups will now be activated at different times on a level instead of permanent power ups that you got from the seal.
* Better, updated, tutorial.

I am still working on this update and figuring out when it's done.

When the new version is released, I will put the old v.1.5. on a branch that you can access in case you're in love with the old game.

Last, would you be interested in joining in playing (and maybe testing), the new version before it's released? 
Let me know in the comments. 
I am listening for everything.

notes.notes:

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

Have fun.

notes.title: Penguin with a Pumpgun is on it's way!
notes.notes:
Penguin with a Pumpgun is soon released on Steam with compatibility for Linux, Windows and SteamDeck.

I started this project in March 2022, believing I could finish the game in half a year. I was wrong, but even though it has taken a bit longer I am happy to announce that the game is out VERY soon.

To celebrate, I have uploaded a new demo resembling the final game's first three levels.

Let the fun begin :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43317888/b64f672f8948ae3afc5b8e50711543449d5ee31a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New, updated demo
notes.notes:
The Penguin with a Pumpgun demo has been updated to reflect the actual gameplay as it is being developed. This means a harder game, raging zombies and other cool stuff.

The demo has been updated with
* New track "Egypt" by Original Fire.
* New track by SwedishWargoat.
* A random seed between 0-64! That means 128 possible levels in this demo!
* Changed Elderly Zombie behaviour drastically.
* Improved Young Zombie behaviour.
* Improved Heavy Zombie behaviour.
* Some RNG-related fixes / additions.

Good Luck, Have Fun with v1.2!

notes.notes:

Lighting effects from alpha has been added.
